kactivitymanagerd.exec_start.description: Absolute path to the kactivitymanagerd executable. Usually installed by the kactivitymanagerd package.

kactivitymanagerd.runtime_dir.description: Runtime directory for temporary/state files (e.g., IPC sockets). Typically resolved at runtime from XDG_RUNTIME_DIR.

kactivitymanagerd.cache_dir.description: Cache directory for non-essential persisted data (e.g., thumbnails, transient activity metadata).

kactivitymanagerd.config_dir.description: Configuration directory for user-specific activity settings and rules.
